held.title: Exit code 4 changes meaning from "recreate required" to "feature disabled".
held.body:
Before this change, `check` exited with 4 when a recreate was needed. Now that case exits with 3, and 4 means the `rolling-updates` feature is off. Two kinds of caller can misread this:
- Scripts written against the old behaviour.
- Any operator logic that reads the job's exit code, if it runs an older Keycloak image that still exits with 4 for recreate. An operator built with the new constants would read that 4 as "feature disabled" instead of "recreate".

I couldn't see the operator code that reads this exit code, so this depends on how it handles values it doesn't expect. Make sure the operator treats any non-zero code (including 4 from older images) as "recreate", and call out the exit-code change in the release notes.
